falsification_conditions.condition: Primary risk index (SPX or the engine's tracked equity benchmark) closes more than 5% below the bottom_2024_aug template reference low within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% bottom analog is invalidated; price has broken the prior-bottom structure the HOLD/UNKNOWN call is leaning on

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70 on any session in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Regime is a blowoff, not a moderate 38 hold; the current non-directional call is wrong

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls below 50% while similarity to a named breakdown or continuation-lower pattern rises above 75%
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: UNKNOWN is resolved against the bottom template; the hold predicated on that match no longer holds

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
